commit.message:
feat(2d): Slot Undercut for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters

Four cutter kinds with a head wider than the neck (t_slot, keyseat,
dovetail, lollipop) and one operation that cuts with them.

The generator (machining2d::undercut) cuts a straight or circular slot
at one depth. It changes Z at one XY station only, outside the wall:
down, sideways in, the centre pass and the radial stepover passes,
sideways out, up. The pass offset comes from the widest point of the
cutter profile, not from the tip. An entry slot too narrow for the
neck is refused by name.

The verifier has a new mode (Mode::Undercut) and law: a move that
changes Z while material is in or over the head is UndercutLift
(blocking), and a neck or holder band with material above its bottom
is a ShankHit. Both are read again against the stock that the earlier
operations left. The solid law reads a dovetail as a frustum and a
lollipop as a full ball, and gives the head top the allowance of the
tip.

The field stock removes the true profile as the union of the head and
the neck solid (Stock::simulate_undercut, SdfTool::Dovetail). The
column engines cut nothing for an undercut: a column cannot hold air
below material.

App: OpParams::SlotUndercut (tag 44), the project file mirror, the
stamp digest, heights, the part solid law, the kept-parts law. The
generic MCP tools create and edit the operation and its cutters. UI:
the tool kinds, the operation page, five original icons. The starter
catalog has one cutter of each kind.

Fixes #1444

fix(sim): grow the undercut heads in the keep-out check

The merge of main brought the "Do not touch" check (#2055). Its
swept atoms did not know this branch's Atom::cap field and the
dovetail and lollipop heads, so camcraft-sim did not build.

- avoid_poly: the swept atom keeps the source atom's prof and cap.
- rho_expanded: a dovetail grows as its r cylinder; a lollipop grows
  as the capsule of its ball over the atom's Z stretch (the cylinder
  when the atom is shorter than the ball). Each is an upper bound for
  any vertical stretch, so the check can warn early but never miss.

Pinned by verify::swept::tests (brute-force Minkowski check).

Refs #1810
